title: Dirt by Sour Milk at The Tank #dirtplay #thetanknyc #sourmilk #theatr...
transcript: I sometimes steer away from interactive theatre pieces because too many of them have left me cringing for the performers trying desperately to get folks to actually participate. But I heard good things about this one, and they were all true. Dirt at The Tank is so well conceived and well executed that you'd have to be crazy not to be an enthusiastic participant. It's basically a local government simulation, complete with mayoral elections and various ballot issues. Everyone picks a character and votes as them while literal decades go by. The whole experience is pretty involved, but it's guided and very impressively detailed. For example, they've implemented some clever elements that humorously reflect the realities of local government such as corruption and lobbying. Aside from intelligently speaking to the nature of how difficult it is to prioritize a seemingly infinite number of local issues, it's just a great time — a funny, entertaining, and truly unique theatrical experience. Dirt is running at The Tank through this weekend. With that, another program for my collection.
